description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity demonstrating the use of the Action Bar and options menu, including menu item creation, icon usage, and handling item selection with Toast messages.

classes.name: ActionBarMechanics
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating Action Bar features and options menu handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and requests the Action Bar feature before setting the content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu items, sets their display options and icons, and adds them to the menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection by displaying a Toast with the selected item's title.
